title: hr — employee/contract/department deep L3
key_finding: hr_contract does NOT exist as a standalone community module in Odoo 19 — contract data is integrated into hr as hr.version (versioned snapshots per employee, replacing the old hr.contract model). Migration plans that reference a separate hr_contract module must be revised.

migration_alerts.message: hr.contract model does not exist in Odoo 19 Community. It has been superseded by hr.version. Any data migration script referencing hr.contract must be repointed to hr.version.
group_hr_manager_all_accounts does not exist in the community module. Only group_hr_user and group_hr_manager are defined. Any permission mapping referencing the third group must be reconciled.

analytic_account_id is ABSENT on hr.employee in community. Cost centre linkage requires Enterprise or a bridge module (e.g. hr_payroll_account). SMEsPlus must confirm whether this feature is needed and whether an Enterprise licence covers it.

hr.employee.active is a stored relation to resource_id.active. Archiving must go through action_archive (not a direct write to active=False) to trigger the departure wizard and clear manager/coach back-references correctly.
